issue.title: Update all dependencies in all languages to their latest versions

repository.name: medical-neural-network-ml
repository.description: A plan to do research on how to teach medical neural network for processing medical data

issue.body:
## Summary

This updates every dependency in every ecosystem of the repository to the newest release on the registry on 2026-10-17. That covers:

- the Python package (`pyproject.toml`, `docs/requirements.txt`) and the UniMedVL runtime lock;
- GitHub Actions and the pre-commit hooks;
- runner images, workflow Python and llama.cpp.

Two pins are held behind, each with a written reason: torch 2.8.0 and transformers 4.57.6 in the UniMedVL runtime. Everything else is at its latest release.

Fixes #19

Supersedes Dependabot PRs #13, #14, #15, #17 and #18. **#16 (transformers 5.19.0) must not be merged:** upstream UniMedVL breaks on transformers 5 (F3 below).

The full evidence is in the dev log, [`dev/log/issues/19/pulls/20/`](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/tree/issue-19-5e219937bdea/dev/log/issues/19/pulls/20):

- [requirements.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-19-5e219937bdea/dev/log/issues/19/pulls/20/requirements.md): every requirement and where it is met;
- [versions.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-19-5e219937bdea/dev/log/issues/19/pulls/20/versions.md): the full per-ecosystem tables;
- [analysis.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-19-5e219937bdea/dev/log/issues/19/pulls/20/analysis.md): findings F1–F15;
- [research.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-19-5e219937bdea/dev/log/issues/19/pulls/20/research.md): sources, major-version notes, best practices, upstream reports.

## Versions (pinned on `main` → this branch; latest from the registry)

Every "latest" was resolved from the PyPI JSON API and the GitHub releases/tags API (`experiments/issue19_resolve_latest.py`, output in `data/latest.json`). It was not taken from memory.

### Python package

| Dependency | main | This branch = latest | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python (`requires-python`) | `>=3.9` | `>=3.11` | 3.9 and 3.10 are end of life; CI matrix 3.11–3.15 |
| hatchling | unpinned | `>=1.32.4` | |
| ruff | `>=0.8.0,<0.9` | `>=0.17.1,<0.18` | The cap admits the current release and keeps the hook and the extra in step |
| mypy | `>=1.13.0,<2.0` | `>=2.4.0` | Major; upper bound dropped |
| pytest | `>=8.3.0` | `>=9.1.1` | Major |
| pytest-asyncio | `>=0.24.0` | `>=1.4.0` | Major |
| pytest-cov | `>=6.0.0` | `>=7.1.0` | Major |
| pre-commit | `>=4.0.0` | `>=4.7.0` | |
| scriv[toml] | `>=1.7.0` | `>=1.8.0` | |
| pillow | `>=10.1` | `>=13.0.0` | Three majors |
| sphinx | `>=7.4` | `>=9.1.0` | Two majors; the `docs` extra now needs Python 3.12+ |
| furo | `>=2024.8.6` | `>=2025.12.19` | |
| myst-parser | `>=3.0` | `>=5.1.0` | Two majors |

### UniMedVL runtime (`scripts/unimedvl-requirements.in` → `.txt`)

This was 20 hand-written top-level pins. It is now a 55-package lock compiled with `uv pip compile` for Python 3.13. Every package is at its newest release except these:

| Package | main | This branch | Latest | Why not latest |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Python | 3.10 | 3.13 | 3.15 | torch 2.8.0, triton 3.4.0 and the flash-attn wheel ship cp39–cp313 only |
| torch (+ torchvision 0.23.0, triton 3.4.0, nvidia-* 12.8) | 2.6.0 | 2.8.0 | 2.14.1 | Newest torch with a prebuilt flash-attn wheel (2.8.3.post2) |
| transformers | 4.49.0 | 4.57.6 | 5.20.1 | Upstream's code fails on 5.x (`KeyError: 'default'` in `ROPE_INIT_FUNCTIONS`). Patched past that, it generates different tokens. Reported as uni-medical/UniMedVL#10 |
| tokenizers | 0.21.1 | 0.22.2 | 0.23.3 | transformers 4.57.6 requires `<=0.23.0` |
| huggingface-hub | — | 0.36.2 | 2.2.0 | transformers 4.57.6 requires `<1.0` |
| mpmath | — | 1.3.0 | 1.4.1 | sympy (via torch) requires `<1.4` |

numpy 1.24.4 → 2.5.4 and opencv-python 4.8 → 5.0 are major updates that were checked against upstream's code (F4, numpy below).

### Actions, runners, toolchains and hooks

- **Actions.** Every action is SHA-pinned, and each SHA was checked against its tag. Two were behind and are bumped: codecov-action v7.0.0 → v7.1.1 and zizmor-action v0.6.4 → v0.7.1 (zizmor 1.31.1).
- **Runners.** `ubuntu-24.04` → `ubuntu-26.04` (including the ARM runner), and `macos-15` → `macos-26`. Workflow Python 3.13 → 3.15.
- **Tools.** llama.cpp b11609 → b11707.
- **pre-commit.** pre-commit-hooks v5 → v6, ruff-pre-commit v0.8.6 → v0.17.1 (hook id `ruff` → `ruff-check`) and mirrors-mypy v1.13 → v2.4. The new `check-jsonschema` hooks validate `dependabot.yml` and the workflows.

## Major versions: what changed in the code

| Update | Effect here | Change (finding) |
|---|---|---|
| pytest 9 | No removed API is used | Adopted the native `[tool.pytest]` table and `strict = true` |
| pytest-asyncio 1.x | A start-up `PytestDeprecationWarning` that pytest's `-W` never sees. `python -W error::DeprecationWarning -m pytest` stopped with an INTERNALERROR | `asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = "function"` (F10) |
| pytest-cov 7 | Dropped its subprocess measurement, so the `python -m medbench.cli` tests stopped counting | coverage's `patch = ["subprocess"]`: monitor.py coverage 88.5% → 94.3% (F11) |
| Sphinx 9.1 | Requires Python ≥ 3.12 | One Sphinx pin kept. The `docs` extra is documented as 3.12+ in pyproject, README and CONTRIBUTING (F12) |
| ruff 0.16/0.17 | Formats Python inside Markdown, which reached captured CI logs and case-study data | `extend-exclude` mirrors pre-commit's `exclude`. Fixes for the new lint rules (F8, F13) |
| mypy 2 | No new errors with the repo config or `--strict` Overrides for `peft` and `huggingface_hub`, never imported by `src/`, removed (F8) |
| numpy 2 | ruff `NPY201` (the migration guide's own check) is clean on upstream UniMedVL `f51aa0a` and on this repo | `NPY` rules enabled so future numpy changes are caught |
| opencv-python 5 | Exact `warpAffine` interpolation changes one augmentation by one grey level | Accepted and recorded (F4) |
| torch 2.8 | The flash-attn wheel on `main` had the wrong C++ ABI | New `cxx11abiTRUE` cp313 wheel with SHA-256 (F5) |
| Python 3.12+ in CI | Unclosed `urllib.error.HTTPError` objects raise `ResourceWarning` | Errors are closed after reading in `backends.py` and `real_data.py`, and the test server closes its socket (F14) |

### New features adopted (hand-rolled code removed)

- pytest's `[tool.pytest]` table and `strict = true` replace `[tool.pytest.ini_options]` and `--strict-markers`.
- coverage's `patch = ["subprocess"]` replaces pytest-cov's removed `.pth` hook.
- `tomllib` replaces try/except fallbacks, and `datetime.UTC` replaces `timezone.utc`.
- `zip(strict=True)` replaces silent truncation of parallel sequences.
- A `uv pip compile` lock replaces hand pins.
- Dependabot `multi-ecosystem-groups`, `exclude-paths` and `versioning-strategy: increase` keep the pip and pre-commit pins moving together and the floors at the latest release.

## Bugs found by the update

- **F1: `wilson_interval`** returned `0.9999999999999999` instead of `1.0` for 4/4 correct. This surfaced on `macos-26` / Python 3.15, where `libm` gives a `z` one ulp away from the Linux value. Exact bounds are now returned at 0 and n, with a test over ±1 ulp of `z`.
- **F5:** the flash-attn wheel on `main` had the wrong C++ ABI.
- **F14:** HTTP error answers were never closed. `test_openai_backend_closes_error_answers` and `test_error_answers_are_closed` failed before the fix.
- **F15:** with its default strategy, Dependabot's weekly group would bump the ruff and mypy hook revisions but not the dev extra's `>=` floors, and fail the same-version tests. `versioning-strategy: increase` fixes it, and `test_dependabot_raises_the_pip_floors_with_the_hooks` covers it.

## Security

The Dependabot alerts open on `main` drop from 25 to 8. 17 are fixed by the new pins. The 8 that remain are in the held torch/transformers pins, and each is accepted in `scripts/audit_dependencies.py` with the reason it does not apply to UniMedVL inference (evaluation in `data/dependabot-alerts-eval.txt`). Alerts close only after merge. `pip-audit` on the UniMedVL lock reports no unaccepted vulnerability.

## Upstream reports

- **Opened:** [uni-medical/UniMedVL#10](https://github.com/uni-medical/UniMedVL/issues/10) (transformers 5 breaks the vendored Qwen2 RoPE). It includes the traceback, the versions, the local workaround and a suggested fix.
- **Already reported, linked rather than duplicated:**
  - [huggingface/transformers#39753](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/39753);
  - [rhysd/actionlint#682](https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/issues/682) and #761 (`ubuntu-26.04` label), whose workaround is in `.github/actionlint.yaml`;
  - [rhysd/actionlint#654](https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/pull/654).

## What is not done

- **GPU run of UniMedVL on the new stack.** No GPU runner is registered for this repository, so `Model Tests` skips that job. What was verified instead:
  - upstream's `chat()` on CPU with a tiny random model generates the same token ids as on `main`'s pins;
  - the flash-attn extension imports against torch 2.8.0;
  - `pip-audit` passes on the lock.

  The first GPU dispatch after merge is the remaining check.

## Tests

Run locally on the final code commit (logs in `data/verification/`). Everything passes:

- `pytest` on Python 3.15 and 3.11, run under `python -W error::DeprecationWarning -W always::ResourceWarning`: 948 passed, 45 skipped (opt-in network/model/GPU), no warnings.
- `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `mypy src/`, `python scripts/check_file_size.py`.
- `sphinx-build -W -b html docs …` and `pre-commit run --all-files`.

New or changed tests:

- the pytest start-up check under `-W error::DeprecationWarning`;
- subprocess coverage;
- ruff skipping the evidence directories;
- the closing of HTTP error answers;
- the Wilson bounds;
- the one-version-per-dependency checks between hooks, extras, docs requirements and the UniMedVL Python.

## Requirements report

### Dependabot pull requests merged before this issue was created These Dependabot pull requests could not be merged automatically and are still open: - [#13](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/pull/13) deps: bump the python-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 12 updates → `main` — not passing: [Compatibility / Python 3.9 on ubuntu-24.04](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38956637946/job/117161041309) (failure), [Compatibility / Python 3.12 on macos-15](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38956637946/job/117161041008) (failure), [Compatibility / Pipeline Status (Compatibility)](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38956637946/job/117161833391) (failure) — skipped: merge conflict with the base branch - [#14](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/pull/14) deps: update mypy requirement from <2.0,>=1.13.0 to >=1.13.0,<3.0 → `main` — not passing: [Compatibility / Python 3.12 on macos-15](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38956645024/job/117161064859) (failure), [Compatibility / Pipeline Status (Compatibility)](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38956645024/job/117162009605) (failure), [CI/CD Pipeline / Test (Python 3.13)](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38956645281/job/117161350182) (failure), [CI/CD Pipeline / Pipeline Status (CI/CD)](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/38956645281/job/117162377856) (failure) — skipped: merge conflict with the base branch - body:
Superseded by https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/pull/22 (issue #21), which moves UniMedVL to transformers 5.20.1 (newer than 5.19.0 here) together with torch 2.14.1.

Why this one could not merge:
- `test_unimedvl_pins` asserted `transformers==4.49.0`.
- On transformers 5, upstream UniMedVL fails with `KeyError: 'default'` because `ROPE_INIT_FUNCTIONS` no longer has that key.

#22 fixes both:
- `scripts/unimedvl_server.py` puts back the 4.x default RoPE initialiser and serves upstream's flash-attn import from torch's `varlen_attn`.
- `tests/test_unimedvl_upstream.py` runs upstream's `chat()` on the lock, so a transformers update that breaks upstream fails CI.
- On the same weights, 5.20.1 gives the same tokens and logits as 4.57.6.

Upstream report: https://github.com/uni-medical/UniMedVL/issues/10

issue.title: Update all dependencies: UniMedVL to torch 2.14.1 and transformers 5 on Python 3.14, Dependabot uv for its lock, llama.cpp b11738 on CUDA 13.4

repository.name: medical-neural-network-ml
repository.description: A plan to do research on how to teach medical neural network for processing medical data

issue.body:
Fixes #21

Updates every dependency the repository pins to its newest release on 2026-10-19. This also applies and supersedes Dependabot's #13–#17, and fixes what kept them from merging.

The evidence is in [`dev/log/issues/21/pulls/22`](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/tree/issue-21-f7500eb08675/dev/log/issues/21/pulls/22):
- [requirements.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-21-f7500eb08675/dev/log/issues/21/pulls/22/requirements.md): every requirement of the issue, with its status and evidence.
- [versions.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-21-f7500eb08675/dev/log/issues/21/pulls/22/versions.md): one table per ecosystem, resolved from PyPI and GitHub, with a reason for every row that is not at the newest release.
- [analysis.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-21-f7500eb08675/dev/log/issues/21/pulls/22/analysis.md): findings F1–F16, with root causes.
- [research.md](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-21-f7500eb08675/dev/log/issues/21/pulls/22/research.md): sources, majors crossed, new features adopted, verification, and how hive-mind's dependency-update best practices were applied.

## What changed

### UniMedVL runtime (`scripts/unimedvl-requirements.in` → `.txt`, the one real lockfile)
- **Moves:**
  - torch 2.8.0 → 2.14.1
  - transformers 4.57.6 → 5.20.1
  - huggingface-hub 0.36 → 2.2
  - Python 3.13 → 3.14
  - The lock grows from 55 to 68 packages.
- **flash-attn removed (F2).** torch was held at 2.8 because flash-attn publishes no wheel for torch ≥ 2.9 or cp314. `scripts/unimedvl_server.py` now serves upstream's `flash_attn_varlen_func` from torch's own `torch.nn.attention.varlen.varlen_attn`. This deletes the wheel download, its SHA-256 and the C++ ABI check. The arguments match torch 2.12+ (F12), and the CPU fallback is kept.
- **transformers 5 (F3, F13).** transformers 5 removed the `"default"` RoPE initialiser that upstream's vendored Qwen2 looks up. `restore_default_rope` puts it back. The one `FutureWarning` that upstream's code triggers is filtered by its exact message.
- **Same outputs (F4).** Upstream's model gives the same tokens and logits (max difference 0.0) on torch 2.8 + transformers 4.57.6 and on torch 2.14.1 + transformers 5.20.1.
- **New CPU job.** `unimedvl-cpu` runs upstream's `chat()` on the lock against golden tokens and logits whenever the lock changes. Its fixture used to resolve the model directory after changing into upstream's code directory, so the job failed until e947cbd fixed that (F16).
- **Dependabot updates the lock (F7).** A `uv` entry for `/scripts` replaces the exclusion that kept Dependabot away from it.
  - Dependabot updates a group's members one at a time (dependabot/dependabot-core#16390). torchvision, triton and tokenizers each need the matching release of torch or transformers, so with every package pinned exactly, nothing could ever move.
  - They are now named in the `.in` without a version. The lock pins them, and an update of torch or transformers carries them along. `experiments/issue21_dependabot_lockstep.sh` replays this.
- **Left behind (16 rows).** These are torch 2.14.1's exact pins of its CUDA 13.0 libraries, plus sympy's `mpmath<1.4`. The reasons are in the `.in` and in versions.md §2.

### Python package, docs, actions, hooks, toolchains
- mlx-vlm 0.7.8 → 0.7.9. 0.7.9 reads sampling defaults from the checkpoint, but `MlxBackend` always passes `temperature=0.0`, so this does not affect it (F9).
- Every other floor in `pyproject.toml` and `docs/requirements.txt`, all 17 actions (SHAs checked against their tags) and every pre-commit hook were already the newest release, and this was checked again. ruff's `<0.18` admits the current release.
- llama.cpp moves to b11738, and the GPU build to CUDA 13.4 (F15).
- **Bug fixed (F6).** The GPU job unpacked llama.cpp's CUDA runtime where the CUDA backend could not find it.
- **CUDA 13 floor (F8).** It needs an R580+ driver and drops Maxwell, Pascal and Volta. This is documented in `docs/hardware-workflows.md`.
- Shell and Jinja have no package manager of their own. The shell scripts download llama.cpp and install the lock. The only Jinja file is scriv's fragment template.

### Dependabot #13–#17 (F1)
- #14, #15 and #17 were already on `main` through #20.
- #13 and #16 are applied here, at newer versions.
- They failed because `test_unimedvl_pins` asserted exact versions (and #14 on the old mypy bound). The pin tests now check what the code needs (torch ≥ 2.12, transformers ≥ 5, a lock that matches its `.in`).
- Each Dependabot PR has a comment pointing here, and Dependabot closes them once this is on `main`.

### Advisories (F5)
- The 14 accepted advisories in `scripts/audit_dependencies.py` and Dependency Review's `allow-ghsas` list are deleted.
- pip-audit finds no known vulnerability in the package or the new lock.
- The 8 open Dependabot alerts on `main` are fixed by the new pins.

## How to reproduce and test

```bash
python -m pytest                                 # 951 passed, 47 skipped
pre-commit run --all-files
sphinx-build -W --keep-going -b html docs _site
python scripts/audit_dependencies.py             # no known vulnerabilities, none accepted
# The lock is reproducible (run from scripts/, as its header says): no diff
(cd scripts && uv pip compile unimedvl-requirements.in -o unimedvl-requirements.txt \
  --python-version 3.14 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28) && git diff --exit-code scripts/
bash experiments/issue21_dependabot_uv_compile.sh  # Dependabot's own compile: only the header differs
bash experiments/issue21_dependabot_lockstep.sh    # pinned trio never moves; carried trio moves together
```

**Tests added or changed:**
- `tests/test_medbench_model_run.py`: pins match what the code needs; the lock matches its `.in`, and the carried packages are pinned there; Python and llama.cpp have one value everywhere; the CUDA runtime layout.
- `tests/test_unimedvl_attention.py`: the shim's fallback matches a reference; its call matches `varlen_attn`'s signature; `varlen_attn` still has no CPU kernel; a CUDA comparison runs on the GPU runner.
- `tests/test_unimedvl_upstream.py`: upstream's `chat()` gives the golden tokens and logits on the lock with CPU torch (the `unimedvl-cpu` job in `model-tests.yml`).

Local logs are in [`data/verification/`](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/tree/issue-21-f7500eb08675/dev/log/issues/21/pulls/22/data/verification).

## Upstream reports
Each report has a reproduction, the versions, the workaround kept here and a suggested fix:
- uni-medical/UniMedVL#10: [comment](https://github.com/uni-medical/UniMedVL/issues/10#issuecomment-6272845731) on transformers 5 (RoPE initialiser, deprecated helper). It also withdraws the "different tokens" claim.
- Dao-AILab/flash-attention#2995: [comment](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention/issues/2995#issuecomment-6272858359) about there being no wheel for torch ≥ 2.9 or cp314.
- pytorch/pytorch#201457 (new issue): `varlen_attn` has no CPU path.
- dependabot/dependabot-core#16390: [comment](https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/issues/16390#issuecomment-6273265798) showing that `uv pip compile` updates also resolve group members one at a time.

## Not verifiable here
- **UniMedVL and llama.cpp on a CUDA 13 GPU.** No GPU runner is registered, so `test_cuda_uses_varlen_attn_and_matches_the_reference` and the GPU job run on the first GPU run. The runner needs an R580+ driver and a Turing or newer GPU.
- **mlx-vlm 0.7.9 on Apple silicon.** The calls were checked against 0.7.9's source, and the mocked tests pass.
- **Two checks fail on `main` only and need a repository admin (F14).** "Release Preflight (credentials)" and "Branch Rulesets" pass on pull requests by design, and each failure message on `main` names the admin action. This PR does not change them.
